run_mlx_lm_generate_with_hook: run mlx_lm.generate with a custom attention hook applied in-process from an evolved program
load_module_from_path: dynamically load a Python module from an arbitrary filesystem path without requiring it on sys.path
apply_hook_from_program: load an evolved hook program and apply its attention optimization to mlx_lm.models.qwen3.Attention
create_metal_qwen3_optimization_hook: create a factory function that returns apply and remove callables for monkey-patching the Qwen3 attention class
remove_attention_hook: undo the monkey-patch on mlx_lm.models.qwen3.Attention by restoring the original Attention class
